items: Hats are found now: you start with the plain hat, and each spell hat lies somewhere on an island (the Helmet on a cairn, Harvest among berry bushes, Sentry on a lookout...), one find a night, hinted by its constellation through the telescope
A hat you find goes on the hats' floor in the Parlour; the floor fills up as you find them
The bum bag and the backpack are found on their own too (hung on a stump, against a log), not in the travel trunk
